title: A fix that adds a new module cannot be closed
what: In relay queue done --fixed-by (lib/relay_queue.py, the check near line 1197), a test that fails at the parent only because it cannot import a module the fixing commit adds counts as failing before the fix; any other error still refuses.
why: 28 Oct: closing two-branches-start-on-the-same-file-unnoticed (fixed by de283320, which added plugins/front/lib/relay_lanes.py and tests/test_lanes_state.py) was refused: the test at the parent 0644594e cannot import the new module, exits neither 0 nor 1, and relay queue done says it cannot tell. Every fix whose cure is a new module hits this; the item stays open although it is fixed.
failing_case: relay queue done two-branches-start-on-the-same-file-unnoticed --fixed-by de283320 --test tests/test_lanes_state.py::Lanes::test_overlap_skip refuses: 'cannot tell whether ... fails at 0644594e52b1 ... it did not run to a pass or a fail'.
pass_cases: The same command closes the item.
A test that errors at the parent for another reason (a syntax error in the test, a missing fixture) still refuses.
A test that passes at the parent still refuses with 'that commit did not fix it'.
where: tests/test_queue_close.py (a queue-done test in a temporary folder)

fact: Edited where: folder entry named as a file (found 28 Oct, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-where)
